description: Returns metadata for a leaf route: available facets with their valid values, data column names and units, frequency options, and date range. Call this before eia_query_route to discover valid facet IDs, facet values, column IDs, and frequency codes. Each facet returns a capped window of its values with value_count and values_truncated alongside; pass facet and values_offset to page through the rest of one facet. To find a value by name in a large facet (plant, entity, and mine IDs run to thousands), pass values_query: each facet keeps only the values whose id, name, or alias contains it, values_matched counts them, and values_offset pages the matches. A values_offset past the last value of a facet returns an empty window for it and a notice naming the count to page against. Facet values are fetched from separate EIA endpoints, merged, and cached per route for 24 hours, after which the next call fetches the route again; a facet whose values EIA did not return is left out of facets, named in unavailable_facets, and fetched again by the next call. When a refresh fails, the cached values are served instead, with a notice naming when they were fetched.

facet.description: Restrict the response to one facet by ID (e.g. "stateid"). Use with values_offset to page a facet whose values were truncated, or with values_query to find a value in it. Omit to get every facet.

route.description: Leaf route path (e.g. "electricity/retail-sales", "steo"). Discoverable via eia_browse_routes or eia_search_routes. Whitespace and slashes are normalized, then one complete leading v2 segment is removed: "/v2/electricity/retail-sales/" resolves to "electricity/retail-sales". Full URLs and /data suffixes are not normalized.

values_offset.description: Index of the first facet value to return, applied to every facet in the response. Use the value named in a truncation hint to continue past the cap. With values_query, indexes the matching values.

values_query.description: Keep only the facet values whose id, name, or alias contains this text, ignoring case (e.g. "palo verde" on plantCode). A plain substring match, not a pattern or a ranked search. Applied to every facet in the response, before values_offset and the cap. Leading and trailing whitespace is ignored. Omit to list every value.

name: eia_describe_route

data_columns.description: Data columns available for this route.

items.description: A data column available for this route.

id.description: Column ID — use in the columns parameter of eia_query_route.

date_range.description: Route metadata date range in the default-frequency context, not a bound across all frequencies.

end.description: Metadata end period for the default frequency; another frequency may extend later.

start.description: Metadata start period for the default frequency; another frequency may extend earlier.

default_date_format.description: Period format for the default frequency (e.g. "YYYY-MM").

default_frequency.description: Default frequency ID used when none is specified.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `upstream_invalid_response`: EIA returned an unusable response body or a missing route or data envelope. `upstream_unavailable`: EIA answered with a retryable HTTP service failure. `upstream_timeout`: EIA did not answer the route metadata request or the route-tree build in time: one attempt passed 45 s, or the call passed its 56 s deadline across retries. A value list that times out is named in unavailable_facets instead. `route_not_found`: Route does not exist in the EIA taxonomy. `route_not_queryable`: Route is a category node with sub-routes, not a queryable leaf. `facet_not_found`: The facet input names an ID the route does not expose. `facet_unavailable`: The facet input names a facet whose value list EIA did not return after retries. `rate_limited`: EIA rate limit hit on the route metadata request, or on the value list the facet input names. `upstream_unreachable`: EIA could not be reached (connection refused or reset, DNS failure) on the route metadata request or the route-tree build. A value list the facet input names fails as facet_unavailable instead. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

facets.description: Filterable dimensions. Each facet has an ID and a window of its valid values. Restricted to one entry when the facet input is set. A facet named in unavailable_facets is left out.

items.description: A filterable dimension for this route.

id.description: Facet ID — use as key in the filters parameter of eia_query_route (e.g. filters: { "stateid": "TX" }).

value_count.description: Total values this facet has upstream, independent of the returned window and of values_query.

values.description: Valid values for this facet dimension, starting at values_offset and capped at EIA_FACET_VALUE_CAP. With values_query, only the matching values, in upstream order.

alias.description: Short alias, when provided by EIA.

id.description: Facet value ID — use as filter value.

name.description: Human-readable name. Falls back to the alias, then to the id, on the values EIA sends without one.

values_matched.description: Values of this facet whose id, name, or alias contains values_query — what values_offset indexes and values_truncated is measured against. One ID listed under two historical names counts twice. Present only when values_query is set.

values_truncated.description: True when values stops short of values_matched when values_query is set, otherwise of value_count. Call eia_describe_route again with this facet ID, the same values_query, and values_offset set to values_offset + values.length for the next page.

query.description: API query value for this frequency.

notice.description: Default-frequency date-range context, composed with guidance for exhausted facet windows, a values_query no value matched, unavailable facet values, or cached values served because their refresh failed.

unavailable_facets.description: Facet IDs whose value lists EIA did not return after retries, left out of facets. Each ID still filters eia_query_route — only its values are missing. Call eia_describe_route again to re-fetch these lists alone. Absent when every facet is in facets.

items.description: Facet ID whose value list EIA did not return.

values_offset.description: Index of the first facet value returned, echoing the requested offset.

values_query.description: The values_query each facet was narrowed by, as matched after trimming. Absent when no values_query was sent.

title: Describe EIA Route
